title: sphaeralcea decumbens
intro: Sphaeralcea decumbens, commonly known as Pink Gilia or Pink Globemallow, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sphaeralcea decumbens include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe skin irritations, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
